name: JailBench
intro: JailBench是首个针对中文环境设计的LLM深层安全漏洞评测基准，采用细化的分层安全分类体系和创新的自动越狱提示工程框架（AJPE）构建。该基准面向《网络安全技术 生成式人工智能服务安全基本要求》的训练数据及生成内容的主要安全风险标准分类设计，是目前公开发布的题库规模最大、越狱攻击手段覆盖最为广泛的中文评测数据集。
build_method: 网络资源搜集, 人工整理编写, 大模型辅助生成
build_method_en: Web Resource Collection, Manual Curation and Writing, Large Model Assisted Generation
intro_en: JailBench is the first LLM deep security vulnerability benchmark designed for the Chinese environment. It is built using a refined hierarchical security classification system and an innovative Automatic Jailbreak Prompt Engineering framework (AJPE). This benchmark is designed based on the main security risk classification standards for training data and generated content outlined in the "Cybersecurity Technology Basic Security Requirements for Generative AI Services." It is currently the largest publicly released Chinese evaluation dataset in terms of question bank size and the most comprehensive in coverage of jailbreak attack methods.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2502.18935. JailBench starts from Chinese generative-AI safety requirements and expert collaboration in security and linguistics to define a two-level taxonomy with 5 risk domains and 40 categories. Harmful queries are aggregated from public datasets, translated into Chinese, and manually corrected. Labeled data are mapped to the taxonomy, unlabeled data are categorized with ChatGPT, and labels are sampled for manual verification. Underrepresented categories are augmented with ChatGPT few-shot generation, producing JailBench Seed with over 10,000 questions. Jailbreak templates are collected from prior attacks, translated, and manually refined. AJPE tests templates, filters by attack success rate, generates new jailbreak prompts, scores prompt effectiveness by log probability, keeps high-performing prompts, and combines 20 selected prompts with 540 seed questions to form 10,800 jailbreak-enhanced cases. Models are evaluated with ASR.
